title: Maintainer action: untick HotCRM's Starter Template in the production cloud admin (Marketplace → App Templates), per the maintainer's decision on #35366
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Maintainer-action: in the production cloud admin, Admin → Marketplace → App Templates, untick "Starter Template" on HotCRM (`pkg_afe88436-3708-4c7a-abf8-e4f4c7cfe06a`, `app.objectstack.hotcrm`) — done when `GET https://cloud.objectos.ai/api/v1/marketplace/packages?q=hotcrm` returns `"is_starter": false` for that row

Source: the maintainer's decision on a decision card in seat objectstack#1's project thread, 2026-11-23 10:23Z: 「不算,改成非模板」. HotCRM is not a starter. Card #35366 carries the reading.

## 维护者速读
- 你定了 HotCRM 不算入门模板。生产上要改这一项，需要你本人在云端管理后台操作，席位和开发都没有生产后台权限。
- 要你做的：打开生产云端管理后台 → Marketplace → App Templates，找到 HotCRM，取消勾选「Starter Template」。大约 1 分钟，马上生效。
- 另有代码修复 cloud#4937：以后 HotCRM 自己发布时，「不是模板」这个设置也会生效，不会再被改回来。它不影响你这一步，两件事可以各做各的。

## Why it needs the maintainer's hands

- Starter listings are platform-curated. On production, an author's publish can set the flag but cannot clear it; the publish route only sets it. cloud#4937 fixes that, but it reaches production only after it merges and the next production release ships, and the release is the maintainer's gate.
- No fleet session can reach the production admin, or even read `cloud.objectos.ai`; the container proxy refuses it.

## Related

- #35366: the card. It stays open until this card's done-when holds and cloud#4937 is decided.
- cloud#4937: the publish-route fix. A first-party seed's `is_starter: false` now clears the flag, so a later HotCRM publish keeps it false.
